occupation: Insulation Workers, Floor, Ceiling, and Wall
task_text: Fit, wrap, staple, or glue insulating materials to structures or surfaces, using hand tools or wires.

occupation: Insulation Workers, Floor, Ceiling, and Wall

occupation: Insulation Workers, Floor, Ceiling, and Wall
